policy.tool: accepted vLLM --tool-call-parser values for the repo's OWN chat template in the pinned image; 'none' = the template has no tool format vLLM can parse; null = not evaluated (not a generative LLM, or ambiguous)
policy.reasoning: accepted --reasoning-parser values; 'none' = no separate reasoning; null = not evaluated
policy.kind: accepted kinds; multimodal generative models accept vision-llm and llm (DGXMM serves both through the llm path)
policy.split: repos with split=holdout were labelled and added after the rules had been tuned on the rest; they measure generalisation
